attributes.role: encrypted API-key / token store, driven by the boru vault subcommand
read-only, HashiCorp-style HTTP API for secret provision (boru vault serve), authenticated by capability tokens
why basic no longer depends on check: the 23 symbols it used, which moved into core as pure primitives, which became a core-owned analysis seam, and the two gates that keep the edge from coming back
the shared declarative tabnas grammar artifact (parser/go/grammar.json): contract, loader pair, and the batch-migration state

the measured verdict on a shared module below core and parser: Value alone closes over 75.7% of core/go, so the cut as posed is a rename — includes the piecetool -closure method and the priced seam alternatives
the 2026-08 checker/compiler completeness review and its §9 implementation record — the living index of the HOF-compilation graduations and the remaining frontier work

the coverage program for core/ts (the sibling of ENG-COVERAGE-PARITY, one layer down): the staged work list, the ratcheting TS_CORE_GATE_LINES floor, and the measurement that core/spec is a cross-engine SPEC and not a coverage instrument
the standalone 100%/100% coverage program for eng/go and eng/ts: the ratcheting gate floors (make cover-gate-eng, make test-ts), the gap inventories, and the staged plans
the parser twin parity audit: the render defects the stream oracle found, the parser/spec corpus that replaced the self-referential battery, and the open divergences

the Go/TS parity program for core, parser and basic: the three shared TSV corpora and their two-runner rule, the capability table that forces core/ts before basic/ts, the divergence ledger, and the finding that an uncovered branch in one port is where a divergence hides
CLI, REPL, type checker, formatter, LSP, registry client, vault, supervisor

competency_results.question: Which assertions conflict, supersede, or corroborate one another?
competency_results.notes: corroboration = duplicate canonical claims share one deterministic id

competency_results.question: Which possible entity matches remain unresolved?
Which entities and assertions fail validation?
What are the direct neighbors of a given entity?
competency_results.notes: sampled on the first canonical entity; callable for any id

competency_results.question: Which assertions involve a given entity, predicate, source, or time range?
competency_results.notes: sampled on the first entity and source; callable for any value

competency_results.question: Which one-hop and two-hop paths connect two entities?
competency_results.notes: traversal depth is bounded at two hops by design

competency_results.question: Which graph claims require human review?
competency_results.notes: identity reviews, disputed/unresolved and low-confidence assertions, error issues

competency_results.question: Which code units does the repository build from, what does each depend on, and what depends on it?
competency_results.notes: code-derived: go.work membership and DIRECT go.mod requires; depends_on is directed, so the two lists differ
